sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer Policy Schedule)

room_rent.note: Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract sub-limited to ₹40,000 per eye per policy year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting for illnesses; 90 days for lump-sum HIV/AIDS benefit; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions except HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, hysterectomy, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 11

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded in Annexure II

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims cannot be contested except on grounds of fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly payment; 15 days for monthly instalment payment

free_look.note: Applicable only for new individual policies; not on renewals or policies with tenure less than 1 year

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary treatment, ART for HIV, STDs, cosmetic/prosthetic devices for disability, stem cell storage
